headline: Once-in-a-generation solar eclipse wows millions in UK and Europe
summary: A rare solar eclipse captivated millions across the UK and Europe. Over 95% of the Sun was obscured in parts of Cornwall. Spain witnessed the full spectacle of a total solar eclipse.

headline: Watch: Moment 'surreal' solar eclipse witnessed in UK and Europe
summary: A video captures the 'surreal' solar eclipse over the UK and Europe. More than 90% of the Sun was covered by the Moon in the UK. A total eclipse was visible in Spain and Iceland.

headline: Temperatures to soar to 38C as amber extreme heat warning comes into force
summary: Temperatures are forecast to reach 38C, triggering an amber heat warning. Extreme heat will spike on Thursday with records expected to fall. A rare warning is in place due to the escalating high temperatures.

headline: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov states Putin cannot claim victory in Ukraine. Muratov believes Putin can only destroy, not conquer, Ukraine. The war is now in its fifth year, according to the exclusive BBC interview.
